clauses.quote: All Teachers who are separated by DCPS according to the provisions of this article shall have the right to reapply to DCPS at any time.
clauses.subject_text: All Teachers who are separated by DCPS according to the provisions of this article

clauses.quote: If rehired, such Teachers shall be placed on the next salary step for which they would have been eligible at the time of their separation.
If rehired within one year of separation, such Teachers shall incur no break in service for pension purposes.
The Parties agree that all provisions of this Agreement are subject to the availability of funds.
clauses.notes: Joint condition precedent limiting obligations to fund availability.

clauses.quote: Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as a promise that Congress, the DC Council, or any other organization shall appropriate sufficient funds to meet the obligations set forth in this Agreement.
clauses.notes: Legal interpretation clause limiting appropriation guarantees.

clauses.quote: DCPS agrees to provide financial certification that DCPS can meet the obligations of this contract before moving toward final approval.
